palette.notes: Measured palette_size 1 is not usable (the still came from the black TikTok end card after ~8.5 s), so no count. By eye: navy-black ground, a few blues for clothes and hair, white and pale-blue highlights, pink accents on ribbons and cheeks; everything in shadow drifts to blue.

lighting: Flat front light on the character; depth comes from a big blue offset drop-shadow copy of the figure on the back wall rather than from modelled light.
silhouette: Tall anime girl, full body, one arm raised high: the raised arm and the big hair tuft make a clear diagonal outline; the darker blue duplicate behind her doubles the silhouette.

motion.timing: Measured 7.31 drawings/s, median hold 66.7 ms (p25 66.7, p75 100), on 2s: a looping dance at ~7 drawings per second, poses alternating between the wave-up key and a hand-to-cap key every ~1 s on the sheet.

texture: Clean pixels with no visible dithering (dither_share 0.0); small equaliser bars of square pixels in the corner as a graphic accent.
camera: Locked square frame (576x576), character centred; no camera moves. Loop ends after ~8.5 s into the TikTok end card.

acting.enters: Already in frame at 0 s; no entrance.
acting.acts: A short dance loop: waves one arm up, tips the cap with a wink, back to the wave; personality comes from the wink and the cheeky hand-on-hip.
acting.exits: Never exits; the clip simply loops.
acting.depth: One plane; the offset shadow copy on the wall fakes a second layer and makes the flat sprite feel stage-lit.

techniques: animated on 2s at ~67 ms holds: a chunky, readable dance rhythm
offset darker-blue silhouette copy behind the hero as a cheap depth/stage-light effect
wink + cap-tip key as the character beat inside a loop
limited cool palette with pink accent for the face and ribbons
feel: dark navy stage + bright hero + blue shadow double + dance on 2s = loopable idol energy
for_fred: Give Fred a 2-key 'signature' gesture (a fin wave and a wink) animated on 2s at ~67 ms, and drop a darker offset copy of his silhouette behind him so he pops off any background in a vertical reel.
